about: #6203: 10 #6420 gate-run adjudications (4 keep, 3 residual, 3 contain; seeded 6203) re-read blind against the image by an Opus subagent (same family as the adjudicator, so agreement is an upper bound).

rows.note: Both garble Eusebius VC I.14-17: A inverts sense with 'ὑπ' ἀπίστοις φύλαξι' and 'παρέχει οὐκ ἐμφανῆ μαρτυρίαν' (print ~'τελείας ἂν ἐμφανῆ μαρτυρίαν') and has 'περιμένοντας' for 'θεμένους'; B is worse, with invented phrases like 'ἐξ ἀπολύτων ὧν ... ἐποίει', 'ᾗ μύθῳ εἶπον', 'ἔν τε τοῖς θεοσεβέσι φαίνῃ', 'σοφίας τῆς ὑπερτάτης' and 'προτιμοτέρους ἡγεῖσθαι' (print 'περὶ πολλοῦ τιμᾶσθαι').
Both faithful; A has small slips ('gloria Domini' for 'gloriæ', 'focius', 'procefferunt') and B has 'Carthaginienses' for 'Carthaginenses'.
Both match the leaf; trivial differences only (B 'haber filius', 'Prädestination' for 'Prädestinatio'; A normalises 'Gewöhnlicher').
Schonberg letter to Copernicus is transcribed correctly by both; A keeps the abbreviations and B expands them.

Hebrew and Vulgate columns are near-identical (both read 'dñs' where the print has 'dd.'); in the Greek column A substitutes 'ἐπανήξετε' for 'ἐπιστραφήσεσθε' and 'ἐξαναγκὰς' for 'ἐξεναντίας', where B follows the print.

Both corrupt the Philo De providentia excerpt about equally: A opens the section with 'Πἔννοιαν ἔτι λέγεις' (print 'Πρόνοιαν εἶναι') and has page 827 for 227; B has 'καὶ θνητός' for 'γενητός', 'λυόμένος ἐνστάσεις' for 'ἀντιθέσεις προτάξας', 'ὠμότητα ἐκβαλών' for 'ὠμότητα καὶ βίαν' and 'πενέστατοί ... φλαῦροι'.

A adds labels that are not on Fludd's plate ('Sulphur', 'Argentum vivum', 'Vitriolum', 'Fortificatio', 'Machinæ') and misses 'Auripigmentum'; B leaves out the small inner-ring labels but invents nothing.
A matches the 孔淑芳/徐景春 text spread, with small slips in the headnote ('暮春時節美麗湖景' for '暮春時和美西湖景'); B describes an illustrated spread ('三老一夜逸') from another leaf.

The hand reads 'Philippus quondam Rex Francorum', which B has and A turns into an invented 'Wesaliarum'; A keeps 'Et hoc dicto ceram proiecit in ignem', which B garbles; both misname the 1525 sect ('Haereticorum'/'Anabaptistarum', the hand looks like 'Rusticorum'), and the middle paragraph is garbled in both.

The first entry discusses 'ἔφαλοι', which B keeps; A replaces it throughout with 'ἀκάτους' and writes wrong headwords ('Ἀγχίαλος ... Idem quod αἰγιαλὸς', 'Ῥαχίαλος' for 'Παράλιος'); B garbles some Greek quotations but keeps the entry structure.
